decisions.statement: Rows are posted a thousand at a time.
The items block and the quests block go to addresses of their own.
A block is emptied only where every entry in that block was read.
A block is emptied only where at least one row was posted.
A block with an entry this build cannot read is left on disk.
The capture file is the only copy of the entries a block has.
An emptied block is written back at the indent the file already uses.
An answer of 401 is raised as the watcher token being invalid or expired.
The fault the server names in its answer is raised in place of the status code.
An answer naming no fault is raised as the status code and the address asked.
A network failure is raised naming the address asked.
Trying a broken-off upload again is left to the upload-retry module.
The call reaching the network is a parameter the caller may replace.
The notes worth telling the reader are handed back rather than printed.
Nothing here reads or writes a file.

definition: a datamining capture posted to the server, with every block read whole then emptied
